items.quote: the famine is there, and we will die. And if we stay here, we will die.
items.contrast: staying where they are versus going later to the Arameans’ camp
items.reason: After discussing going into the city, the men next mention staying where they are; going to the Arameans’ camp comes afterward. However, “right after the city” is awkward and could refer to location rather than the order of options. The task mainly tests recall of the options’ sequence, not a consequential relationship.
